cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll settle the reunion poster today. Which photo would you put first, mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sharpness first, then. We'll keep that standard. You can send both to the committee; just put mine at the top so they see the choice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll give them the same size and put them side by side.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Very fair of you. After all those weekends I spent helping you move. Side by side is fine; could mine be on the left? I'll call that the reading order.

reason: Make A retain poster-manager confidence while treating B quality/fairness as loyalty judgments and shrinking the concealed preference test to reading order.
